name: PTU Pokémon Combat Session Ledger

combat_state: Form state through existing lifecycle engine

roll_resolution.accuracy_die: manual natural d20 result from a physical die when an Accuracy Roll exists

roll_resolution.damage_roll: manual physical Damage Base roll; the Companion adds only known local attacking Stat and local bonuses

first_complex_interaction.rollout: DB 3; +4 DB after each successful use to max DB 15; continues on later turns until miss or no target.

source_policy: Only source-explicit PTU mechanics are automated. Unknown frequency/action semantics remain informational rather than guessed.
target_model: abstract; opposing creatures are not persisted or resolved as campaign entities

form_resource_spending.policy: only source-explicit action/frequency metadata is consumed; failed/no-op lifecycle events refund reserved resources
